hypotheses.title: Options Implied Volatility Skew Reversion with 30d Backfill and 10d Decay Smoothing
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Calibrated directly from Candidate f6ed9c9e (which achieved Sharpe 2.00 and 0 self-correlation). Implied volatility call-put skew (implied_volatility_call_60 - implied_volatility_put_60) captures medium-term institutional tail-risk hedging relief. Using ts_backfill(..., 30) ensures continuous instrument coverage across all 3,000 instruments, eliminating weight concentration. Expanding decay to 10 days smooths turnover down from 50% to under 20%, directly boosting Fitness into the Gold Consultant threshold (>= 1.50).
confounders: Sudden market-wide volatility shocks causing non-linear skew widening across all equities simultaneously
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if backfilled skew signals fail to generate positive information coefficients across monthly horizons.

candidates.expression: group_rank(ts_decay_linear(ts_backfill(implied_volatility_call_60 - implied_volatility_put_60, 30), 10), market) - 0.15 * group_rank(ts_decay_linear((close - vwap) / close, 5), market)

hypotheses.title: Options Skew Reversion via Cross-Sectional Z-Score Distribution
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Applies cross-sectional z-score normalization (group_zscore) with 60-day backfill to eliminate rank-clustering and weight concentration. Z-score scaling weights equities proportionally to the magnitude of skew dislocation rather than uniform ranks, mirroring the proven architecture of approved alpha c47f1989. Paired with 10-day linear decay for optimal 15% turnover and maximal risk-adjusted return.
confounders: Outlier implied volatility spikes in distressed low-dollar stocks skewing cross-sectional z-scores
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if z-score standardization exhibits higher turnover without improving the Sharpe ratio.

candidates.expression: group_zscore(ts_decay_linear(ts_backfill(implied_volatility_call_60 - implied_volatility_put_60, 60), 10), market) - 0.15 * group_zscore(ts_decay_linear((close - vwap) / close, 5), market)

hypotheses.title: Options Skew Alpha with 5-Day Price Delta Low-Churn Rebalancing
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Couples the powerful 60-day call-put skew signal with 5-day price-delta mean-reversion rebalancing. 5-day price delta operates at a lower frequency than intraday VWAP, reducing turnover down into the 12-16% sweet spot. Lower turnover dramatically enhances the Fitness denominator while preserving the raw Sharpe 2.00 predictive power.
confounders: Persistent momentum regimes where 5-day price delta reversals generate adverse selection
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if price delta rebalancing dampens sub-universe Sharpe below platform cutoff.
